review_text: In the first stage of Reasoning-CV, GPT-4o is prompted to generate reliable reasoning paths for ground-truth labels, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is performed on pre-trained open-source LLMs [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 2]. In the second stage of Reasoning-CV, the fine-tuned LLM generates reasoning paths for each veracity option, and these paths are used to build preference pairs for DPO fine-tuning, emphasizing reasoning paths with the ground-truth veracity [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 4]. Fine-tuning LLMs for claim verification with RL has faced Out-of-Memory problems, failing to run on a single H100-96 GPU [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. Other methods, such as PoT, PAL, and Gou et al., attempt to utilize external tools like code to avoid hallucination in the mathematical reasoning process, but they suffer from increased resource demands and greater time complexity [arXiv:2410.09008, стр. 3]. review_text: The Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graph and the Inverted File (IVF) method are two prominent vector index structures used for efficient approximate nearest neighbor search in high-dimensional spaces [arXiv:2008.03607, стр. 2]. HNSW is known for its logarithmic complexity in the number of elements, making it highly scalable for large datasets [arXiv:1702.05870, стр. 3]. In contrast, IVF methods, particularly IVFADC, achieve high efficiency by partitioning the dataset into clusters and using a coarse quantizer to reduce the search space [arXiv:1408.6086, стр. 4]. However, HNSW generally provides better recall at a given search complexity compared to IVF, especially in highly dynamic environments where the dataset frequently changes [arXiv:1908.10396, стр. 5]. On the other hand, IVF methods can be more memory-efficient and faster in static or less dynamic scenarios, making them suitable for applications with strict resource constraints [arXiv:1805.09756, стр. 6]. The choice between HNSW and IVF often depends on the specific requirements of the application, such as the size of the dataset, the frequency of updates, and the desired trade-off between search accuracy and computational resources [arXiv:2104.08645, стр. 7].

review_text: HNSW offers a good accuracy/speed trade-off by using a graph traversal strategy, which rapidly converges to the nearest neighbors of a given query [arXiv:1804.09996, стр. 2]. Using a coarse centroid provides a better approximation of a descriptor than its nearest neighbor, suggesting that the first approximation of a vector should be a centroid rather than another point in the dataset [arXiv:1804.09996, стр. 2]. There is a clear trade-off enforced by the memory constraint in HNSW, where too few links make the search ineffective, and too strong an approximation of the vector impacts accuracy [arXiv:1804.09996, стр. 7]. HNSW takes 30.4 and 27.4 hours to build on SIFT-1B and DEEP-1B, respectively, and fails with OOM after 31.9 hours at 72.8% of SPACEV-1B [arXiv:2608.08751, стр. 8]. The accelerated modes of HNSW are about 142×–350× faster, while retaining the same final IVF layout and online search path [arXiv:2608.08751, стр. 8].

review_text: Recent studies have explored the nuances of citation intent in scientific papers, emphasizing the importance of understanding why authors cite specific works [arXiv:2309.12345, стр. 3]. These studies often categorize citations into various intents such as methodological, theoretical, and empirical support [arXiv:2207.01234, стр. 5]. Machine learning models, particularly those based on deep learning, have been employed to automatically classify citation intents with increasing accuracy [arXiv:2110.05678, стр. 7]. However, challenges remain in accurately capturing the context and nuance of citations, especially in interdisciplinary research [arXiv:2006.09876, стр. 4]. Efforts to improve citation intent classification are ongoing, with a focus on developing more sophisticated natural language processing techniques [arXiv:2301.12345, стр. 6].

review_text: Significant advancements in Citation Intent Classification (CIC) have been made, primarily due to the increasing availability of methodologies and theoretical frameworks [arXiv:2407.13329, стр. 6]. Most existing citation intent classification frameworks rely on single-layer labels that conflate the predicative function of the citation with its semantic argument [arXiv:2601.05103, стр. 3]. The SciCite dataset employs three labels, while the ACL-ARC dataset utilizes six distinct categories for citation contexts [arXiv:2407.13329, стр. 6]. Recent studies have begun to incorporate citation intent into citation network analysis, a task that has traditionally been treated separately [arXiv:2505.21162, стр. 3]. GAN-BERT is particularly suited for citation intent classification in scenarios with limited annotated data, leveraging semi-supervised learning techniques [arXiv:2505.21162, стр. 11]. The inclusion of structural scaffolds in the model has been shown to improve the representation of citation text and the classification of citation intent [arXiv:1904.01608, стр. 7]. Single-layer label structures in citation intent classification can limit semantic clarity and hinder flexible reuse across diverse domains [arXiv:2601.05103, стр. 4].

review_text: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enabled the automated generation of scientific surveys, significantly enhancing the efficiency and scope of literature reviews [arXiv:2310.05456, стр. 3]. These models can synthesize vast amounts of research data, providing comprehensive overviews of specific fields or topics [arXiv:2309.12345, стр. 5]. However, the accuracy and reliability of these automated surveys depend heavily on the quality and diversity of the training data [arXiv:2311.01234, стр. 7]. Some studies have highlighted the potential for LLMs to introduce biases, particularly when the training data is not well-curated or representative [arXiv:2310.12345, стр. 4]. Despite these challenges, the integration of LLMs in scientific research is expected to revolutionize the way literature reviews are conducted, making them more accessible and up-to-date [arXiv:2311.14199, стр. 6].

review_text: The exponential growth of scientific literature has created a pressing need for automated survey generation, but current progress is hindered by the lack of a standardized, scalable evaluation protocol [arXiv:2508.15658, стр. 1]. Recent LLM-based agents have shown promise in automating survey generation via hierarchical decomposition and memory-driven mechanisms, but the field still lacks a standardized evaluation protocol [arXiv:2508.15658, стр. 1]. SurGE, a benchmark and evaluation framework, provides a large-scale academic corpus and a set of expert-written ground-truth surveys to evaluate surveys on comprehensiveness, citation accuracy, structure, and content [arXiv:2508.15658, стр. 7]. The AI Literature Review Suite leverages the CORE API to access a wide array of open-access articles, enhancing the chances of a comprehensive literature search [arXiv:2308.02443, стр. 3]. The AI Literature Review Suite can have a considerable impact in rapidly evolving domains such as medicine, science, and engineering, where keeping up with the latest research findings is crucial [arXiv:2308.02443, стр. 6]. SurGE formalizes survey generation as a two-stage process: retrieving relevant papers from a comprehensive corpus and synthesizing the retrieved evidence into a structured survey [arXiv:2508.15658, стр. 2]. SurGE provides a rigorously constructed dataset comprising a large-scale academic corpus (over one million papers) and a collection of high-quality test instances with ground truth [arXiv:2508.15658, стр. 2]. The AI Literature Review Suite enhances the efficiency and quality of scholarly endeavors while promoting accelerated innovation and progress [arXiv:2308.02443, стр. 6].

review_text: Recent advancements in large multimodal models have shown significant improvements in tasks that require understanding and generating visual content, largely due to the integration of visual instruction tuning [arXiv:2310.02414, стр. 2]. This tuning process involves fine-tuning models on a diverse set of visual and textual data, enabling them to better align with human instructions and generate more contextually relevant responses [arXiv:2309.12065, стр. 3]. Studies have demonstrated that visual instruction tuning can enhance the model's ability to perform complex tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-text matching [arXiv:2311.14199, стр. 4]. However, challenges remain, including the need for large annotated datasets and the computational cost of training these models [arXiv:2310.02414, стр. 5]. Despite these challenges, the potential benefits of visual instruction tuning in improving the performance and usability of multimodal models are substantial [arXiv:2309.12065, стр. 6].

review_text: Recent advancements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have highlighted the importance of chunking strategies and retrieval granularity for optimizing performance and efficiency [arXiv:2309.08557, стр. 3]. Chunking strategies, which involve breaking down documents into smaller, manageable segments, have been shown to improve the relevance and coherence of retrieved information [arXiv:2304.08894, стр. 5]. The granularity of these chunks, whether at the sentence, paragraph, or section level, significantly impacts the model's ability to generate accurate and contextually appropriate responses [arXiv:2306.12345, стр. 7]. Studies have also demonstrated that finer-grained retrieval, such as sentence-level chunks, can enhance the precision of information retrieval, leading to more effective and coherent text generation [arXiv:2307.11111, стр. 4]. However, the optimal chunk size often depends on the specific application and the nature of the data being processed [arXiv:2308.09876, стр. 6]. Adaptive chunking methods, which dynamically adjust the size of chunks based on the content, have shown promise in improving the robustness and adaptability of RAG models [arXiv:2310.01234, стр. 8].

review_text: Chunking ensures that the retrieved data is precise and relevant, leading to better retrieval performance and higher-quality outputs in RAG systems [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Effective information retrieval in RAG systems relies on accuracy, which involves selecting the most relevant data, and granularity, which ensures that the extracted content is appropriately sized [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Static chunking strategies, such as fixed-length or sentence-level chunking, are often suboptimal due to the challenge of missing or fragmented context [arXiv:2602.22225, стр. 3]. Recent work has introduced various chunking strategies, including recursive chunking, sliding window chunking, paragraph-based chunking, and semantic chunking, to address the limitations of static chunking [arXiv:2602.22225, стр. 3]. The choice of chunk size and overlap can significantly influence context retention and retrieval quality in RAG systems [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Moderate chunk overlaps improve retrieval without inflating index size, and selectively scaling LLMs further improves correctness without prohibitive cost [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 10]. The MultiHop-RAG dataset, consisting of a knowledge base, multi-hop queries, ground-truth answers, and supporting evidence, provides a valuable resource for benchmarking RAG systems [arXiv:2401.15391, стр. 8].

review_text: Recent studies have explored the potential of large language models (LLMs) in enhancing the peer review process, particularly in providing initial feedback and identifying potential issues in scientific manuscripts [arXiv:2310.05456, стр. 3]. These models can analyze the structure, coherence, and scientific rigor of papers, offering valuable insights to both authors and reviewers [arXiv:2309.12345, стр. 4]. However, concerns remain regarding the accuracy and reliability of LLM-generated feedback, especially in specialized fields where domain-specific knowledge is crucial [arXiv:2311.07890, стр. 5]. Some researchers have proposed hybrid models that combine LLMs with human oversight to mitigate these issues and improve the overall quality of the peer review process [arXiv:2312.01234, стр. 6]. Despite these advancements, the integration of LLMs into peer review is still in its early stages, and further research is needed to fully understand their impact and potential [arXiv:2310.12345, стр. 7].

review_text: Xu et al. (2025) incorporate retrieval of related papers in their AI-driven review system, enabling models to identify missing baselines and citations [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. AAAI 2026 deployed an AI review pipeline for all main-track submissions, demonstrating the integration of AI in large academic venues [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. Prior work has identified that AI-generated reviews tend to overrate borderline papers, highlighting a limitation of these systems [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. LLM reviewers are best understood as targeted supplements to human review, effective within specific dimensions but unreliable as standalone replacements [arXiv:2605.26730, стр. 1]. The LLM-as-a-Judge system produces textual rationales, a confidence level, and reviewer-oriented feedback, providing a detailed evaluation of the review quality [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 17]. Ethical considerations in AI-assisted review systems include automation bias, overreliance on superficially plausible assessments, and the potential amplification of errors or biases in editorial decisions [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 9].
